title: Mini Armor Enchantment
description: An enchantment that makes you minuscule. Every piece of Armor that's enchanted with Mini Armor reduces its wearer's size by 25 %.
body:
**Mini Armor** is a custom armor enchantment that makes you smaller with every enchanted piece you wear!  
Each piece of armor enchanted with **Mini Armor** reduces your player size by **25%**, stacking up to **\-69%** total when wearing a full set.

Custom enchantment applied via **loot**, **trading**, **enchanting table**, or the `/loot give` command:

```/loot give @s loot mini_armor_enchantment:1```

Can appear in random **structure chests** or via **villager trades.**

Works like a regular enchantment — apply it to **armor pieces only.**

Shrinks your **player model and** **hitbox** per enchanted piece.

Fully multiplayer-compatible: Server-only datapack. Players don't need to install it.
